comparison.objective: Load five fragile slides into separate staining-rack slots, not commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Edge-only grasping, narrow-slot alignment, repeated insertion, and careful release; no rotary tool or dynamic tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Each slide upright within 2 mm of its slot, alone, released, and never fallen or face-contacted versus repeated carriage-stop performance.
comparison.reason: Precision repeated insertion and fragile handling are unrelated to damper calibration.
